title: Salmon Miso Broth
description: A quick Japanese-style broth of miso, mirin and soy sauce simmered with rice, salmon and vegetables.
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled and cut into fine matchsticks
2 salmon fillets, skin removed, cut into bite-sized chunks
TO SERVE (OPTIONAL): chopped spring onions, coriander leaves
steps: In a medium-sized saucepan, bring the stock to the boil, add the rice and simmer for 7 minutes.
Add the miso paste to the pan and stir to dissolve, then add the mirin, soy sauce, carrots and salmon.
Simmer for 3 minutes, add the sugarsnap peas, then simmer for another 2 minutes.
Serve just as it is, or with some spring onions and coriander scattered over.
notes: Miso is a fermented soy bean paste with a distinctive salty, umami flavour. Mirin is a Japanese sweet rice cooking wine. Both available in most big supermarkets near soy sauce and noodles.
